prompts.name: front-western
prompts.prompt: Original dense 1880s Western/Victorian newspaper reimagined for a World of Warcraft Horde guild. Portrait 3:4, 1086x1448 layout. A believable OLD BROADSHEET, not a minimalist template: tightly set tiny serif columns, bold condensed display ad headings, thin black rules, small engraved woodcuts, advertising boxes, slightly uneven letterpress ink on warm aged paper with fibers and creases. Sepia-black ink, tiny restrained dark red Horde sigil. No modern UI, no 3D, no ornate fantasy poster framing, no watermark. The explicitly specified LIVE GUILD DATA AREAS must remain unprinted pale paper for real dynamic text. Fill the specified surrounding areas with ORIGINAL fictional Horde newspaper material, legible text and engravings. No invented player names, statistics or results in static copy. Ads and lore notices are fictional. Keep top-right 30px corner clear for close button. LIVE DATA areas (strict coordinates): masthead x200 y40 w686 h110; date strip x45 y165 w996 h35; large main news headline x45 y230 w996 h120; byline x45 y360 w620 h26; narrow main article x45 y405 w285 h350; illustration caption x365 y728 w340 h50; right live bulletin x740 y405 w300 h370; bottom two live article columns x45 y900 w300 h385 and x385 y900 w300 h385; footer x45 y1380 w996 h30. Keep these exact areas completely blank. Outside these areas, PACK the page with the following original newspaper furniture: upper left small boxed slogan 'THE HORDE READS HERE', upper right little box 'PRINTED IN ORGRIMMAR'; fine double rules around date line. Central woodcut ONLY x365 y405 w340 h310: an orc peon reading a paper on a crate beside a Horde camp. A dense three-column tiny-type FICTIONAL local-news strip at x45 y790 w640 h85, exact heading 'FROM THE NOTICE BOARD', body 'The innkeeper requests that all axes remain outside the common room. A second notice reminds patrons that a wolf is not a cloakroom ticket. The editor welcomes letters, provided they are not attached to arrows.' Bottom-right x740 y825 w300 h500: a large vintage boxed advertisement with engraved axe, heading 'ONE GOOD AXE', subhead 'GRUK & SONS', body 'A clean edge. An honest handle. Try before you buy. Please bring your own target.' Add a small separate notice below 'WANTED: FISHING COMPANION. Must bring own bait. Silence preferred.' Thin editorial column dividers and little ornaments around but never inside live areas. It should already look rich in old newspaper text and art, while reserving the main headline and real data article areas for software.
